## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Backend tests pass (`npm --prefix server test`), and new API behaviour has a test
- [ ] No secrets, passwords or customer data in the code
- [ ] Database changes are in a **new** migration file (no edits to applied migrations)
- [ ] New settings are documented in `.env.example` / `server/.env.example`
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visible changes
